purpose: Finalize the product release plan and resolve the remaining mobile UI blocker.
summary: The team kept Friday as the release target, made the mobile summary layout a release blocker, and agreed on a staged 10% rollout before full release.
key_takeaways: Friday remains the target release date, contingent on QA finishing by Thursday at 5 PM.
The mobile summary layout must be fixed by Wednesday evening.
The release will start with 10% of users and expand if error rates remain normal.
decisions: Keep Friday as the release date.
Treat the mobile summary layout issue as a release blocker.

purpose: Review Acme onboarding research and agree on improvements for first-time users.
summary: Research showed friction around team invitations and workspace setup. The team decided to simplify the first-run checklist and test a guided template flow.
key_takeaways: Team invitation is the largest onboarding friction point.
Users want guided first-run templates rather than an empty workspace.
The next test should compare a short checklist against a guided setup flow.
decisions: Reduce the initial checklist to three steps.
Run a follow-up usability test next week.

purpose: Align marketing and sales on the Q4 launch narrative, milestones, and ownership.
summary: The team agreed on a single launch narrative, assigned campaign and partner outreach owners, and locked the main Q4 milestone sequence.
key_takeaways: The launch story will focus on measurable time saved from meetings.
Marketing owns campaign assets; sales owns partner outreach.
Customer proof points must be ready before the public launch.
decisions: Use one shared launch narrative across marketing and sales.
Finalize campaign assets before partner outreach begins.
Require at least two customer proof points before public launch.
